# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the verbs: watch, stand, act, be strong. Every one of them demands a decision. No one drifts into vigilance. No one stumbles into strength. These things are chosen, and they're chosen daily, often before the sun is up and before you feel like it.

The world will tell you that masculinity is something to apologize for. Scripture tells you it's something to steward. God didn't call you to be passive, distracted, or half-committed. He called you to stand firm when your feelings waver, to act like men when culture says act like children, and to be strong—not in your own power, but in the Lord and the strength of His might.

Here's the truth: you will not rise to the occasion. You will fall to the level of your training. So train. Pray before you scroll. Open your Bible before you open your inbox. Discipline in the small hours builds the man who can stand in the hard ones.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups—but pause at the bottom of each rep and thank God for the strength to move at all. Then text one brother and ask how you can pray for him today.
